sourceText: User authorized executing the ordered milestones until DONE, starting with ClaimAdmissibilityPack interface and read-only pack registry before Quantum verifier, gate policy, and benchmark milestones.
normalizedOutcome: The first milestone is DONE when Proofbound exposes a typed ClaimAdmissibilityPack contract and read-only registry for the built-in code-runtime pack, with smoke evidence proving duplicate ids/surfaces fail closed and no pack can mint production or scientific-truth claims.
acceptanceClaim: M1 is complete if npm --prefix packages/main run test:claim-admissibility-pack-framework passes after build and prints claim-admissibility pack framework smoke passed, while validate accepts the story evidence.
